2Sh-wNaOCrY.descriptionFull:
Sleep To THESE Psalms And See What God Does

Tonight, quiet your mind and rest in the promises of God.

This peaceful Bible reading features some of the most comforting Psalms in Scripture, read slowly and gently to help you relax, release anxiety, and fall asleep resting in God's presence. If you have been searching for Psalms for sleep, Bible verses for sleep, or a way to go to bed listening to God's Word, this video was created for you.

Many Christians have found comfort in falling asleep to Scripture, allowing God's promises to replace fear, worry, overthinking, and stress. As you listen tonight, let the Psalms remind you that the Lord is your refuge, your protector, your shepherd, and your peace.

This reading was intentionally arranged to create a calm and uninterrupted listening experience, combining some of the Bible's most beloved passages about God's protection, faithfulness, mercy, strength, and peace. Whether you are struggling with anxiety, loneliness, spiritual exhaustion, or simply want to end your day with God, may these Scriptures help you rest.

"Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you." — John 14:27

No More Thinking Tonight… Jesus Is With You

Tonight, you don't have to carry every burden, solve every problem, or replay every worry in your mind.

Let the words of Jesus and the promises of Scripture quiet your thoughts as you prepare for sleep. This peaceful Bible reading combines some of the most comforting chapters from the Gospels, Psalms, and Isaiah to remind you of one simple truth: Jesus is with you.

If your mind feels overwhelmed, restless, anxious, or exhausted, allow God's Word to become your place of rest tonight. As these Scriptures are read slowly and gently, may they help you release fear, let go of overthinking, and find peace in the presence of Christ.

Throughout the Bible, Jesus repeatedly reminds His followers not to be afraid. He is near to the weary, close to the brokenhearted, and faithful to those who trust Him. Whether you are facing uncertainty, stress, loneliness, or simply need a peaceful way to end your day, these chapters were selected to help you rest in His promises.

Fall asleep listening to some of the most beloved passages about God's presence, peace, protection, comfort, and unfailing love. Let every verse draw your attention away from your worries and back to the One who holds tomorrow in His hands.

"Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest." — Matthew 11:28
